summary: J1 base used in the main assembly — KUKA KR3 base body (scale 0.49) hollowed out: ⌀81 bore up to the servo seat at z = 77 mm (MG996R hung from below: window, 4 M3 inserts, rib-relief slots), rear-box cavity for the Arduino Uno + 16-channel PWM shield, ⌀49.5 spigot recess and ⌀51–88 thrust ring at z = 90.45 mm for the turret, two tray pillars with M3 inserts, rear USB / DC-jack / cable openings, ⌀10 servo-cable hole through the box roof.

Electronics tray that closes the base from below — 2.5 mm plate (z = 6–8.5 mm in the base frame) with four Arduino Uno standoffs, two M3 holes for the base pillars and a rear lug with a horizontal M3 insert.

Not used in the main assembly (replaced by 01_Base_Kuka). J1 base pedestal part — 95 × 95 × 5 mm flange (4 mounting holes on 73.5 × 73.5 mm), ⌀82/⌀77 mm tower to 57 mm with 24 vent slots, MG996R servo ledge at 45.28 mm with 4× M3 heat-set insert holes.
J1 base top cap — ⌀82.2 × 4.5 mm disc with ⌀76.8 × 1.0 mm spigot; not used in the main assembly (the turret closes the tower).
Imported multi-body KUKA KR3 R540 reference model (51 bodies, scale 0.49) with only the rotating-column body shown; shape reference, not a designed turret.
Separate turret base disc ⌀82 × 10 mm with 25T horn pocket and 4 M3 inserts at (±30, ±15) mm; not used in the main assembly (its function is built into the turret) — it only fits the plain test fork.

One-piece J1–J2 turret in the same coordinate frame as the base — KUKA KR3 rotating-column body (scale 0.49) with its ⌀92 foot (face z = 90.65 mm) and ⌀49 spigot shortened to z = 86.1 mm: J1 horn seat at z = 91.85 mm with 4 M3 holes on PCD 14 and a ⌀22 access well from the channel floor; MG996R pocket tilted 15° in the +Y ear (seat plane y = 29.5 mm, 4 M3 insert holes, rib-relief slots), 698ZZ seat in the −Y ear; J1 axis = part Z axis, J2 axis at x = 9.8, z = 169.05 mm (h0 = 169.05 mm, a1 = 9.8 mm).
Turret sub-assembly — KUKA-style fork with the J2 MG996R, 25T horn and 698ZZ bearing placed by fixed transforms.
13 mm test-print slice of the KUKA-style fork servo ear (y = 21–34 mm) — servo window, tab seat, rib-relief slots and 4 insert holes — for checking the MG996R fit before printing the full fork.

Upper arm (L1 = 127.4 mm) — KUKA KR3 link-arm body (scale 0.49) in the same coordinate frame as the fork: J2 hub cut to the horn face y = 14.65 mm (4× M3 on PCD 14) with a through access cavity and M8 nut trap on the bearing side; J3 fork with an MG996R pocket tilted 15° in the +Y ear (seat y = 30.7 mm, 4 M3 inserts, rib-relief slots) and a 698ZZ seat in the −Y ear; J2 axis at z = 169.05, J3 axis at z = 296.45 mm.
Printed spacer ring ⌀11 / ⌀8.3 × 5.6 mm between the J2 698ZZ inner race and the upper-arm hub.

Forearm elbow block around J3 — KUKA KR3 elbow body (scale 0.49) in the arm frame: servo-side face cut to y = 21.7, recessed horn pocket (bottom y = 15.85) with 4x M3 holes, rear-opening screw cavity, bearing-side face y = -24.0 with M8 hole, nut pocket and 4 hex-key access holes; front recess with 4 M3 insert holes and a wire hole for the fork body.

Forearm fork body — KUKA KR3 forearm solid (scale 0.49): centring boss that seats in the elbow block recess, side-opening wiring cavity, 4x M3 joint holes and a wire hole through the rear wall, 4 hex-key access holes through the front wall.

Wrist body — KUKA KR3 wrist solid (scale 0.49): side bosses trimmed for 0.5 mm gaps, J4 axis at x = 137.2, z = 306.23 mm with a two-arm MG90S horn recess on the +Y face and a dia 8.3 pivot hole on the -Y face; front-loading J5 MG90S pocket (body, tab slot, wire slot, one tab-screw pilot hole), roll axis at y = 0, z = 301.0 mm.

Main assembly up to the upper arm — KUKA base with tray, Arduino Uno and the PCA9685 shield stacked 11.5 mm above it, J1 MG996R + horn, one-piece turret, J2 DS3225 servo + horn, 698ZZ + spacer, KUKA-style upper arm, J3 MG996R + horn, the forearm elbow block and the fork body seated in it (concentric + coincident, free to turn about the forearm axis in CAD; bolted with 4 screws on the real robot); base, tray, J1 servo + horn and Uno are fixed, the turret, upper-arm and elbow groups rotate on J1 / J2 / J3 mates (concentric + coincident/distance, hardware locked to its link); table at y = 0, J1 on the Y axis, J2 axis at x = 9.8, y = 169.05 mm.

Plain test-print fork for checking the MG996R fit — ⌀82 × 6 mm floor, 7 mm servo ear plate (40.6 × 20.7 mm opening, 4 M3 inserts), 8 mm bearing ear with 698ZZ seat, 44 mm gap; J2 axis 27.95 mm above its bottom. Not part of the main assembly.
Test sub-assembly — plain fork with the J2 MG996R (mated), 25T horn and 698ZZ bearing.
J1 base working assembly — pedestal, MG996R, top cap, 25T horn and 4 M3 inserts.
+Y half of the KUKA rotating-column body (split from 02_Base_Turret at y = 0, cut at z = 100 mm) with trial cuts and bosses; styling reference for the turret fork.
